name: generate_image
description: Generate a raster image from a text prompt using state-of-the-art image models. Width and height guide the aspect ratio; the model chooses a supported output size, so the image pixel dimensions may differ from the requested values. The tool returns a URL serving the raw image bytes of a PNG or JPEG image. IMPORTANT: The URL expires after 7 days. The user MUST download the image before the URL expires to keep a copy. **This is a paid feature — each call consumes Figma AI credits against the user's plan (different models have different per-call costs).**

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

model.description: Image model to use. One of: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gemini-3.1-flash-image. Defaults to gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image.

width.description: Requested width in pixels. Together with height, selects the closest supported aspect ratio; actual image width may differ. Default: 1024; max: 2048.

height.description: Requested height in pixels. Together with width, selects the closest supported aspect ratio; actual image height may differ. Default: 1024; max: 2048.

planKey.description: The team or organization key (e.g. "team::1234567890" or "organization::1234567890"). Use the `key` field verbatim from one of the user's plans. If the user has more than one plan, ask which one to use before calling.
